name: Fast Point-Based Isosurface Rendering
aliases: Direct rendering with view plane parallel polygons
definition: A rendering technique that visualizes isosurface cells as non-textured, completely opaque, screen-aligned (view plane parallel) polygons to avoid visibility ordering and surface interpolation, leveraging hardware for anisotropic scaling.
summary: Fast Point-Based Isosurface Rendering is a hardware-accelerated method that renders isosurfaces as opaque, view-plane-parallel polygons to bypass triangulation and visibility ordering for interactive visualization.
